counterfactual_rationale: Record says RoutingMethodType logic failed for grouped-topk configurations such as Mistral Large 3 and needed FlashInfer MoE dispatch fixes. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record fixes Marlin kernel races causing corrupted output and NaNs, and discussion says compute-sanitizer racecheck found a read-write race. A sanitizer, memcheck, initcheck, or racecheck run on the described path would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record ports kv_canary JIT kernels to ROCm, including a wave64-safe reduction instead of a 32-lane shuffle assumption. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says DSV4.1 mHC overlap during eager or PIECEWISE capture left stream-local barriers uninitialized and caused startup failure. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says top-k renorm Triton kernels used int32 offset products, so large batch by vocab tensors could overflow offsets and corrupt loads or stores. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says the NVFP4 TRTLLM MoE backend had scale-layout, routing-bias dtype, and routing-method bugs for a large Qwen FP4 model. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says a refactor omitted per_act_token for a Cutlass MoE FP8 caller and broke Maverick serving. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says AVX2-only CPU targets lacked half dtype kernel support and failed CPU CI. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says the NSA indexer had a dtype mismatch on AMD devices and references an AMD CI failure. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says Triton 3.6 renamed a MXFP4 layout class, breaking the GPT-OSS import on ROCm. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says xFormers encoder-decoder prefill incorrectly cut K and V by prompt length even though vision encoder K/V can be longer. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record explicitly fixes wrong sliding-window attention calculation in flashinfer_backend.py. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says MoRI and AITER FP8 dispatch became incompatible after a MoE oracle refactor and raised NotImplementedError. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says a prior PR broke TPU fused MoE backend selection and TPU CI was the test plan. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says XPU imported tvm_ffi in the DSV4 online MTP module even though apache-tvm-ffi is unsupported, causing ModuleNotFoundError. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says CPU fused MoE lazily instantiated CustomOp activation classes during forward and hit current vLLM config is not set. A CI lane on the affected hardware, driver, compiler, or dependency matrix would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says Forward context mixed Attention and FusedMOE layers, causing FlashInfer to assert when it expected only Attention layers. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says CPU DP plus MoE lacked communicator dispatch and combine, producing gibberish outputs compared with CUDA. A full serving-stack test for the described model and backend would plausibly have exposed it before merge.

Record says a persistent silu_mul_quant shape with hidden size 128 times 33 produced incorrect results because NUM_GROUPS did not divide evenly across warps. A randomized or edge-case kernel-vs-reference test for that shape or configuration would plausibly have exposed it before merge.
